title: Nathan Savant - Modular Motivations: Building Reactive Roguelike NPCs
speaker: Nathan Savant
talk_title: Modular Motivations: Building Reactive Roguelike NPCs
description: You've built a randomized world, but now you have to fill it with people. Will your NPCs just stand lifelessly or will you give them needs and wants of their own? In this talk we discuss breathing life into NPCs without breaking the budget! Imagine filling your game with supervillains who actually plot and scheme, or a Big Bad who can menace the player with realistic malice! Then watch this talk and imagine no more because I'll show you how to do it!
